about: Data scout ledger (Nick 11:35 PM Nov 4 2026, EXP-097). Candidates found by the scout, license-checked and ranked by new information per GB. Pulled data is counted in docs/data-ledger.json (the Data Division crews A-F, docs/plans/2026-11-05-data-division.md); this file is the pipeline in front of it. Render with: python scripts/scout_ledger.py Scout experiment ids: EXP-1600-1699. Owner = the crew that pulls it (A pbp, B context, D markets); 'scout' = still being probed. Video principle (Nick 12:15 AM): extract features on the fly (numbers, timestamps), never store raw video.
token_rule: tokens = events x 6 for event streams (noggin_tokens vocab v1). Three kinds, counted separately (Nick 11:50 PM): 'events' = new real plays/pitches/balls; 'context-new' = external facts we did not have (odds, weather, refs, injuries, TV slot), counted ONCE per game as unique tokens, with as-fed tokens (repeated on every play by vocab v2) shown only in the why line; 'derived' = computed from data we already hold (WP, leverage, momentum, timeouts left, lineups, player-to-date, standings and playoff odds, rest and travel): adds tokens per play but no new knowledge. Synthetic and augmentation (mirror, re-timing) are never in this file; they are capped at 3x real in data-ledger.md.
info_per_gb_rule: score = new_tokens_m x novelty / raw_gb. novelty 1.5 = adds wall-clock timing we lack; 1.0 = new sport, league or level; 0.5 = more of a league we already hold.

verdicts.green: free to use, credit at most
verdicts.yellow: usable with a stated condition (credit, non-commercial, Nick accepts a rules tab)
verdicts.yellow-B: restrictive terms; usable only under data plan B for personal use; tag personal-use
verdicts.red: not using (bot-block, login, paywall, or terms we cannot meet even under B)

candidates.name: v2 context: pregame line + total per game (all six leagues)

candidates.license: nflverse CC-BY-4.0; SBRO no licence (Nick logs it); ESPN-derived only under plan B for personal use. Lines are importance inputs only, never shown, never a nudge
candidates.why: ~190k games x 6 tokens (spread, total, implied WP, favourite side, line move open-close, closing source). As fed on every play: ~95M plays x 3 = ~285M tokens, but that is repetition, not new knowledge

candidates.name: v2 context: live line state (in-game price moves)

candidates.license: Polymarket documented API, plan B personal use; never shown or used to nudge
candidates.why: the only free in-game line source; ~6k games 2024+ x ~500 minute ticks x 6 tokens. Gap: nothing free before 2024

candidates.why: ~80k outdoor games x ~4 game hours x 6 vars (temp, wind speed, wind dir vs field bearing, precip, gust, lightning flag). As fed: ~31M outdoor plays x 4

candidates.name: v2 derived per-play state (no new knowledge)
candidates.access: computed in the factory: WP before/after + leverage, expected points, margin + run + lead changes, timeouts/fouls/bonus/challenges left, lineup on floor/ice + minutes/rest, player season-to-date and career, foul trouble, pace, possession/drive state, standings + playoff odds (our Monte Carlo), rivalry, rest/travel days, streaks/records in reach, ref tendencies, play-text tokens

candidates.why: ~95M plays held x ~60 extra tokens to reach the 50-100 per play target. Novelty 0 on purpose: it is a lens on data we have, so it never counts toward the new-information goal
